name: Naadim
source:
A traveling dancer who lives at the inn and often puts on shows for the town. Despite the charming smile he wears for his admirers, he seems to exude a slightly distant aura. 

Fun fact: He loves taking naps by the river.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/peachleaf-valley/]official website[/url]]
